ValidationRule.description: Prevents non-CCFL users from creating or updating a PHOCS Complaint with a Topic of Child Care or Residential Care.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSComplaint", AND( NOT($Permission.PHOCSFHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess), NOT($Permission.PHOCSIHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess), NOT($Permission.PHOCSNHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess), NOT($Permission.PHOCSVCHChildCareResidentialCareAccess), NOT($Permission.PHOCSVIHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Topic__c, "Child Care"), ISPICKVAL(Topic__c, "Residential Care") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: As a non-CCFL user, you cannot create a PHOCS Complaint with Topic as Child Care or Residential Care.
